exposure: International Federation of Obstetrics and Gynaecology (FIGO) grading system
outcome: Accuracy of greyscale ultrasound (US) and colour Doppler in detecting PAS
cohort: 36 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa or low-lying placenta involving the anterior uterine wall and associated with PAS, who underwent cesarean hysterectomy between 34 and 36 weeks of gestation
finding: The overall US evaluation was highly significant in predicting the FIGO diagnosis of PAS; however, all ultrasonographic signs were equally relevant in diagnosing grade 1 and/or 2 PAS and were inaccurate in differentiating the subtypes of PAS grade 3.
